title: DX SDK daily scratchpad - docs & sample apps
content:
Quick notes / brain dump for today (focused on docs gaps + sample apps + tutorial fixes)

Top priorities
- Finish lightweight sample app for JS/TS quickstart (auth + streaming example) - target: ship as examples/quickstart-streaming
  - Needs: 1) minimal server example (express) 2) client streaming usage 3) instructions for environment variables (REDWOOD_API_KEY, REGION)
  - Open questions: do we recommend 'fetch' streaming or SDK stream helper? default to SDK helper with fallback to fetch code snippet.

- Fix onboarding tutorial step that confuses users around model selection: wording is ambiguous (latest vs cost-optimized).
  - Replace: "choose best model" -> "choose model based on latency/cost/quality; see table + link to performance profiles"
  - Add small decision tree: prototyping -> small; production latency-sensitive -> quantized variant; embeddings -> use embedding-specific model

- Docs gap: retry/backoff guidance for transient 502s and rate limits. Add recommended backoff policy + snippet using axios/retry.

Daily TODO (rough order)
1) Draft quickstart streaming example (local test) - BLOCKS: need sample account key (use demo key placeholder) [in progress]
2) Update quickstart page with streaming code and small diagram showing request flow [todo]
3) Add a note to troubleshooting: "if you get 403 check org/project settings and token scopes" [todo]
4) Create a mini PR template for examples that includes required files: README, .env.example, test script [todo]
5) Sync with Alex about embedding batch example for Python (he's got a draft) - ping him in #dx-sdk slack [done: pinged at 9:15am]

Notes from last user interview (CS handoff)
- New users expected a single copy/paste sample to try in their app; too many files in repo scare them off. Move quickstarts to single-file example variants.
- Confusion about "region" vs "endpoint". Make wording consistent: use REGION in env var, show explicit endpoint option for Private deployments.

Ideas for sample apps (nice-to-have)
- simple-notes-app: show streaming generation for autosave + optimistic UI (React + Vite)
- faq-bot: embed + rerank pipeline example (python) - show eval metric for reranking
- summarizer-worker: background job example using Redwood Dedicated (simulate batching + KV cache)

Short code snippet to include in quickstart (JS streaming, informal):
const client = new RedwoodSdk({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1.0', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize...' }] })
for await (const chunk of stream) { appendToDom(chunk.text) }
(note: convert to SDK-specific API before final PR)

Pending doc PRs to review
- PR #542 (examples: add react notes app) - needs test + .env.example
- PR #548 (docs: update quickstart wording) - small wording changes; approve after wording + decision tree added

Risks / blockers
- UX review needed for quickstart flow (product wants fewer choices). Schedule 30m with Priya.
- Dedicated/private endpoint examples need staging infra to test. Coordinate with infra team for ephemeral endpoint creds.

Next steps this afternoon
- Pair with Mikka on streaming sample formatting (12:30pm)
- Draft backoff/retry guidance and add to "error-handling" section (aim to land PR today)
- Consolidate single-file quickstarts and add links from main README

Random notes / TODO later
- Add short checklist to repo for adding new examples (include performance note + cost estimate)
- Document recommended quantization profiles per model family (ask Applied ML for latest recommendations)
- Follow up on telemetry: add an event for "started quickstart example" to track dropoff

Scratchy thoughts (notes to self)
- Keep examples minimal. Avoid heavy frameworks. People appreciate 1-file examples and a 1-paragraph explanation.
- Consider a single-page "starter kit" zip that contains minimal examples for JS, Python, and one CLI example.

Slack refs: #dx-sdk (thread: quickstart rename), convo with @alex on sample batching (Mar 2), @mikaela suggested adding a cost callout card on quickstart page.

-- end scratchpad --
